skills.name: Lifesaver
skills.description: Rescues friends who have fallen into the water. Good effects on surrounding allies.  *ATK Speed +230% (10 sec) *Move Speed +130% (10 sec)

skills.name: Air Pump
skills.description: Blows up a tube and attacks enemies. Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *Enemy Skill Resistance -50% (10 sec) *ATK per sec x 1000% Area Damage (10 sec) - Floats enemies into the air with a bubble (12 sec)

abilities.name: Resistance: Deployment Freeze
abilities.description: Rangers with this Ability block enemies' Deployment Freeze Ability.

abilities.name: Deploy Knockback+ : Agility
abilities.description: Has a super high chance of knocking back all Agility type enemies and canceling their Skill Barrier effects when Rangers deploy.  - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 3 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Guardians, Bosses, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
